_meta.second_check: Every high-alert second check in this fictional data is done by an RN. Who may be a second checker is a hospital policy that needs approval; the app uses an RN-only prototype setting.
_meta.scenario: EHR outage 14 Nov 2026, 03:40 to 12:40 (9 hours), across the 07:00 shift change. Recovery in progress at 13:20.
_meta.extra_fields: route_snomed on active_order and med_admin (SNOMED CT route code); note on downtime_event; med_admin.event also uses rate_changed for an infusion rate change; inference_source values are on_device or in_cloud
_meta.drill_sign_in: pin_hash values are placeholders. In Drill mode the app re-creates every seed PIN as 2468 on first load.
